title: Watashi ni Tenshi ga Maiorita! Precious Friends
justification: AniDB special S1 (2023-03-24) has no TVDB episode, was 0x01. AniDB dates from the AniDB mirror at 7dd9b8e; TVDB from its official order. AniDB special S1 (2023-03-24) has no TVDB episode, was 0x01. AniDB dates from the AniDB mirror at 7dd9b8e; TVDB from its official order. AniDB 15869 (Precious Friends, the 2022-10-14 film) is TVDB 0x2 but not in TMDB 84666 season 0, which holds only the 2019-05-24 OVA (the film is a TMDB movie), so the offset 1 claim on S0E2 and the default claim of its special S1 (National Simultaneous Broadcast Stage Greeting Digest, 2023-03-24) on S0E1 are wrong. The rows send the episode and the special to no TMDB episode.
